Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. CXXIX 43800 has synopsis 43803–43805, addressee 43807–43813 and Urban self-protocol 43815–43819. Sections 1–4 continue coherently 43834→43843, 43903→43915 and 43957→43964 to full/short dating 43998–44002. Removed 43836, previous CXXVIII’s possumus note keyed at 43784. Retained this title source note 43838, current reading notes 43959/43961, and disjoint note 44013 restoring vacantia explicitly marked at 43976. The next CXXX begins 44005 as separate Inquisition material; only this act’s precisely keyed note is borrowed from after its heading.
